brand_identity.name: Dra. Amanda Azevedo - Advocacia de Família

brand_identity.aesthetic_archetype: Swiss High-Contrast + Old Money Legal Trust (Archetype 4 & 5 Fusion)
brand_identity.tone: Acolhedor, altivo, empático, altamente profissional e resolutivo.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (or DM Sans)
typography.accent_font: Cinzel, serif (for Monogram and OAB badge)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight
hierarchy.caption_overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-semibold text-sky-600

layout_and_structure.navigation: Glassmorphic floating navbar with blur backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/60 z-50 fixed top-0 w-full
layout_and_structure.hero_section: Kinetic Hero with line-by-line reveal animation, high contrast dark-blue & light-blue badge, dual CTA (WhatsApp + Agendar Consulta), floating lawyer badge
layout_and_structure.marquee: Slow editorial ribbon with low-contrast sky background separating Hero and About sections ('DIREITO DE FAMÍLIA • GUARDA COMPARTILHADA • DIVÓRCIO HUMANIZADO • PENSÃO ALIMENTÍCIA • PARTILHA DE BENS')
layout_and_structure.about_section: Asymmetric Bento grid (2-column on desktop) with Dra. Amanda's portrait, credentials pill (OAB 29.478), personal statement, and key values cards
layout_and_structure.practice_areas: Interactive grid/cards for key family law areas (Divórcio & Dissolução, Guarda & Regime de Convivência, Pensão Alimentícia, Partilha de Bens, Inventários & Partilhas, Planejamento Matrimonial)
layout_and_structure.online_process: 4-Step linear visual timeline showcasing 100% online process: 1. Atendimento via WhatsApp/Video -> 2. Envio de Documentos Digital -> 3. Análise & Estratégia -> 4. Acompanhamento do Processo sem sair de casa
layout_and_structure.testimonials_faq: Accordion list for FAQs + sleek quote card testimonials
layout_and_structure.contact_section: Split layout: Integrated contact form with validation + Direct WhatsApp floating widget and card details
layout_and_structure.footer: Deep Navy background with full legal disclaimers, OAB number, fast links, and custom SVG Monogram logo

admin_dashboard_design.style: High-density dashboard, clean slate background (#F8FAFC), sticky sidebar/tab navigation
features: Secured login modal/page with email & password authentication
Content Tab: Live editable text fields for Hero title, About bio, practice areas, FAQ items
Media Tab: Logo & Lawyer photo URL manager + instant preview
Theme Tab: Dynamic color pickers for Primary and Secondary CSS variables
Section Manager: Toggle visibility & drag/reorder landing page sections
Messages Inbox: Data table of contact form submissions with filter/date tags

animation_guidelines.reveals: Staggered fade-up for section titles and cards
animation_guidelines.hero_kinetic_effect: Masked line reveal on main header text using motion div clip-path
animation_guidelines.marquee_speed: react-fast-marquee with duration 35s smooth infinite glide
